make_functional: create a functional version of a PyTorch nn.Module by extracting its parameters as a separate tuple
make_functional_with_buffers: create a functional version of a PyTorch nn.Module that extracts both parameters and buffers separately
combine_state_for_ensemble: stack parameters and buffers from multiple identical models into a single ensemble ready for vmap
extract_weights: extract all parameters from a PyTorch nn.Module in place and return them as a tuple with names
load_state: reload extracted weights and buffers back into a stateless PyTorch nn.Module to restore it
